annotation.title_clean: Understanding the UK AI labour market: 2020
annotation.title_en: Understanding the UK AI labour market: 2020
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dabhi, K.; Crick, C.; Douglas, J.; McHugh, S.; Zatterin, G.; Donaldson, S. et al.
annotation.summary_en: DCMS-commissioned Ipsos MORI report (May 2021) on the UK AI and data science labour market, using a firm survey, interviews and job-vacancy analysis. It covers workforce diversity, skills gaps, training, recruitment and retention, and recommends policy to bridge skills gaps. The metadata title (AI Opportunities Action Plan) does not match the content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Technical and soft skills gaps are widespread among UK AI employers.
AI workforce diversity is limited, and employers need approaches to improve it.
Recommends aligning university courses with sector-specific AI skills needs.
Ethics training levels are low; ethical standards may eventually be needed.
Job vacancy analysis shows regional demand, salaries and qualifications for AI roles.
